reviews.text: My cat, who usually loves vet visits, had a terrible experience at this location from the moment we walked in. The staff man-handled him and gave him ‘clean’ pheromone blankets covered in hair. They then tried to convince me to bring him in every three months for a prescription he’s been taking for years, even though the previous vet only required an annual visit. It seemed like they were just trying to make money. I thought they’d be a good place to take my cat since they’re tailored to cats but it turned out to be a nightmare.
I've been going to see Dr. Knighton at City Cat Pets for about three years - the team there is incredible. They have given my cat so much love and care. Couldn't ask for a better vet clinic.

A wonderful practice. They are very responsive and provide great follow up after a visit. They are kind and compassionate. I had to put one of my most loved kitties to sleep. They scheduled me right away and they we so supportive.
My second cat has renal disease and I asked copious questions which they promptly answered.

I do have another cat, Jezebel, who they treated unsuccessfully. But to be fair, they recommended a $1500 procedure that I couldn’t afford at the time. Jezebel is scheduled for this treatment very soon and I am hopeful this solves her drooling issue.

I do believe in using specialists when needed but U Penn Ryan Hospital quoted me  $2,500 plus anther probable $1000 in tests.  I am hopeful that City Cat Vets can solve her issue.

I had a cat named Oliver who like Jezebel, was constantly seen for eye problems for which he was prescribed antibiotics. After spending $1000 on repeat visits I say a specialist who told me his eyelashes were growing into his eyes and he needed surgery, which completely solved the issue. So some times specialists are needed.

I am anxious to see how they solve the persistent drooping issue.  But for routine cat care they are terrific.

My senior cat is dealing with several concurrent new diagnoses and issues, and I feel so lucky to have found City Cat Vets. The team is absolutely fantastic. They’re so responsive, friendly, communicative, and caring. They have on-site ultrasounds, X-rays, and a ton of testing capacity without egregious wait times. They are making me feel like I truly am getting the best care for my kiddo.
Really kind, knowledgeable, and helpful staff and doctor

The vets here are exceptional, especially Dr. Knighton, who guided me through a very difficult diagnosis for my cat. She called and emailed me multiple times to check in and see how my cat was doing. At the end, I called for a very last minute euthanasia appointment and they fit me in within hours. Dr. Humenick took care of us at that appointment and he was incredibly compassionate.

I also can’t say enough good things about the front office staff and vet techs. Everyone here really cares for your cat like it is one of their own. They always pick up the phone, respond to an email, and send records when requested. Almost immediately after the visit you get an email detailing the whole appointment. They will also always provide you with an itemized receipt or estimate for future procedures.

I don’t think I will be getting another cat for a while, but when I do - know that I will be back at this practice.

I have nothing but good things to say about City Cat Vets. Dr. Humenick sees my cats Stella and Ash and he is wonderful: knowledgeable, incredibly patient, and has a good sense of humor. I wouldn’t be surprised if Stella is on their top 10 most difficult cats list, but he and the vet techs always get through her exams without batting an eye, despite her acting like the world is ending. It is apparent that everyone here loves cats. I also appreciate that the front desk staff are very responsive over phone and email. Thank you City Cat Vets!

The best! Been going to them for about three years because legit everyone i asked for vet recs said City Cat Vets. And they were correct. I get taken on time for my cat’s standard checkups and the appointment lasts 15-20 mins — super efficient and effective. I’m told about any potential future concerns, and today, Dr. Perner told me the price of a procedure my cat could potentially need in the future so that I can start budgeting now (her exact words, which I loved). I’ve also seen Dr. Humenick here too and he’s excellent, as are the vet techs and the receptionist. Glad y’all are my vet practice!

I have had nothing but positive experiences here and my cat has been seen here for four years. The front desk staff are responsive. The veterinarians and techs are kind and smart. My cat with feline leukemia virus has received incredible and attentive care here! Vet Humenick took the time to educate me and put things in terms I could understand when I brought my cat in for a sick visit recently.
Very kind staff, techs, and Vets. They were thorough with follow-up and going over all options available to us.
i was WAY happier after i switched to Art City.

Our visit with Dr. Andeer and veterinary technician Everett was such a positive experience. Everything was done efficiently and in a calm, low-stress way that made a huge difference for our cat—I honestly think she’d be happy to go back. I really appreciated the thoughtful touches, like Feliway towels in the lobby and using Churu on the towel in the exam room to make vaccines and microchipping as stress-free as possible. The entire visit felt very positive-reinforcement focused, and pricing was very reasonable. We’ll definitely be back for annual visits with all of our cats!

They don’t prescribe needed medicine due to “stigma.” My cat might die due to this gross negligence.

Edit: The alternatives cause constipation which means they can not be given when he is constipated, which is the exact situation for which he needed a med. Hence, the request for the only non-constipating alternative of which I am aware. Another non-constipating alternative obviously would have been fine. This was of course said and yet I received this unreasonable response containing lies that you see below.

My cat Oreo is so well behaved when she goes to City Cat Vets, it says a lot about how good they are with her. She's usually anxious and hiding or hissing at people but she's so mellow with them and they're just amazing with her. I would highly recommend them!

We've had routine checkup and big surgical/dental work done here for about a year now, and it has proven to be a great choice. You can tell that all the care staff here really love cats - and that they are invested in making sure your cat feels safe and gets well. Prices seem typical for good veterinary work too.

I love taking my cats to City Cat Vets for their annual checkup! The front receptionist, Doug, is so friendly, attentive, and welcoming! He creates a warm environment and makes the check-in and check-out process so smooth.

The vet and assistant are always very gentle with my cats and know precisely how to calm them down (mainly with a Churu). They listen to all my concerns and give me excellent guidance on how to continue caring for my kitties!
Most of the staff are very warm and kind. We unfortunately had to put our cat down and everyone was very kind and understanding.

One of my cats was a very sickly cat and I started taking her here as they focused only on cats. The care she received was phenomenal and when it was time to let her go they were so kind and thoughtful during the entire appointment. I moved and I am still taking my other cat here as our experience has been great!

I took my cat there for weight-loss in the past year expressing concerns of her sudden interest in water, new pickiness with food, as well as new G.I. sounds happening. I feel like I kept getting dismissed, it being blamed on age. She ended up in the ER with bilateral kidney infections. After a round of antibiotics, I was told by City Cat Vet that the infection had cleared, was not prepared or informed of the possibility of anemia coming back, or the infection coming back. Expressed concerns when G.I. related vomit was happening just to be back in the ER a month later needing to put my cat down. She died from GI related issues and bilateral kidney infections. If you have serious concerns. about your pet do not come here, because my cat would be alive today if they had ordered a simple ultrasound. It is their job to know that geriatric cats are prone to this, that’s why I paid $300 a visit. Very disappointed and frustrated. Never going back here. Mango deserved better.

Took my cat here twice because her previous owner did before I adopted her and I figured I'd minimize any big changes for her. The first time was for a check up and the vet told me everything looked fine, including her teeth. I took her in a second time for an unrelated issue, this time with a different vet, and suddenly she had tooth resorption and needed dental surgery immediately (which turned out to be true). Not sure how that extreme jump was made - either the first vet was being irresponsibly lazy or doesn't know what she's doing. They gave me a high quote and hounded me about making the appointment while I was emailing about the aforementioned unrelated issue until I straight up had to tell them that I couldn't afford it and was not confident that my insurance would cover it. Instead of working with me on price or suggesting low cost clinics, they just ghosted me and ignored my email. If they had just given me a bit of help I'd probably still be going there for routine care (which frankly is also overpriced) but no chance of that now. Obvious that they don't care about your pet and only care about your money. They're also located on a busy part of South St so good luck finding parking.

I really wanted to like this place but I had a strange experience that made me not want to go back. Made my cat an appointment because I loved the idea of a cat only vet. Everything was fine until we went into a closet sized exam room and they wrapped my cat in a towel for his exam and vaccinations which covered his eyes. I understand this is a strategy but my poor cat was growling and very upset. He’s never growled at a vet appointment! He’s been nervous sure, but not in distress. I truly felt like what they were doing was unnecessary. He showed no signs of aggression until after the towel. I now take him to another vet and he does great there!

The best vet experience I have had with my 9 year old kitty. They handled her with great care and patience, were informative throughout the process and reasonably priced. I will be taking my other cat here as well!

Just encountered a rude phone call. Tried to learn more about services, pricing, steps to set up my cat and the front desk lady really made me feel terrible for not knowing what to do. I’m sure they’re a good vet but that first experience and impression itself just ruined it. I felt diminished and I shouldn’t feel shamed for learning to care for a cat… I’m sure they’re a great provider and I did a lot of research on Philly vets and stumbled on this one all excited to learn…. but I’ll be taking my cat elsewhere!

It’s not the cheapest I’ll be honest about that. But fellow cat owners know that a lot of vets simply don’t like cats. My Bella bubbles is 14 and a very relaxed animal but she’s truly been even more so a dream for this vet. Absolutely no scruffing here !!!!!

My experience with City Cat Vets has been nothing but smooth and positive. Booking an appointment for my cat Juniper as a new patient was unexpectedly easy. When I called to book about 2 months in advance they had plenty of availability, and we completed the intake information and scheduling in less than 5 mins over the phone! When I arrived at the office, I was surprised to see a basket of blankets with artificial calming pheromones to cover carriers, and using one helped Juni stay calm. The vet and tech were both incredibly kind and attentive and treated her with the utmost respect and care. She’s been much more anxious at vets in the past, but CCV was a world of difference. I will gladly continue bringing Juniper here for all her medical needs! Thank you City Cat Vets!

Amazing atmosphere, sweet vets and vet techs, friendly front desk.

They were VERY accommodating and patient with my two special needs kittens. I would imagine they'd be just as lovely with other cats. My kittens have moderate Cerebellar Hypoplasia, they knew exactly what sorts of health problems to check for with them. They were able to give me advice as to how to help with a couple of behavioral issues. They also gave me tubes to collect samples to bring in next time.

I got a high-ball answer when I asked prior to going in how much it would cost. A part of that high-ball cost prediction was the deposit I paid ahead of time to be a new client with them, a part of that guestimation was also the sample testing tubes. They allowed me to take the tubes without quite paying for them, with the understanding that I'd pay for the samples next time I came in. Which was super helpful considering I recently lost my income due to this wonderful 🫲🏻🫱🏻 admin we got going on in this country 🙄 they also said it may be slightly higher just because of the health problems that can come with CH cats. Ended up being affordable, and the deferred payment for samples for next time is beyond appreciated. They also said I could pay ahead of time when I have funds, in case if money is inconsistent in the future.

As an aside, I believe it was one of the other technicians who came out and asked if a cat in their records "did this cat go to heaven?" I'm not a religious person but that was just a sweet lil way of saying that, that being their term for the end of a kitties life, just really sweet to hear.

Big fan, definitely sticking with them for as long as I can.

Having just moved to Philly, I needed a new vet for my cats. I can’t recommend city cat vets enough! James was wonderful with my two cats. Very knowledgeable, kind, and made my cats extremely comfortable throughout their examination. The office itself is adorable. Would highly recommend this place!

This may be an unconventional review. We came to City Cat Vets to do what no pet owner ever wants to do, which is to help our almost 20 year cat cross over after a long life of wonderful cuddles. The staff here were amazing, empathetic, and professional. They made sure our cat was comfortable, loved, and gave us the space to be huge, weepy, snotty messes as we spent our last moments together. They let us have all the time we needed after it was over and they gave us lots of options for how to handle her remains without being pushy about anything at all. They also took care of all of the paperwork and payments upfront so that after we were done grieving in the room all we had to do was leave. I will remember their kindness for a long time and also thank you for letting us use the whole box of tissues.

Friendly staff, on time appointments, reasonable pricing

They handle our pets with such care! They are an amazing team
expensive but worth the extensive post visit summaries and excellent gentle care
Thank you Dr. James and team for your patience with our sassy girl!

I bring all of my cats here and they did their very best to help us with our first loss of our beloved baby girl, Lorelei. They are amazing at what they do and are so supportive during times of hardship and grieving.

I will always recommend anyone and everyone to come here for their cat care. It sucks that general veterinary care has to be so expensive, but the fine staff here is worth their money for sure! I thank them so much for all they do for our fur babies. <3
My favorite vet I've ever taken my cats to

This vet is a gem. Truly the best place to take your cat. I'm so thankful it's in my neighborhood. My cat Beignet received great care from the doctor and technicians here during her last few months. The doctor is knowledgeable and caring and the front desk staff are kind and helpful. They were always willing to help steer me in the right direction when I had questions about the wellbeing of my baby.

Everyone here is super personable and informative. Dr. Knighton and the Tech that checked out Fred, my 10 week old street urchin, were super gentle with him. They gave me a clear overview of what to expect for upcoming visits. They also used treats to help Fred be calm while he received care.

I also really appreciated that the front desk staff is able to give you a ballpark quote for the cost of the visit. There's nothing like being blindsided with fees.
I called around to a few places before picking City Cat Vets. Their pricing seems very fair in comparison.

I totally recommend them if you've got a kitty. The office is dog free. The space is super calm and quiet. The staff are A+ from the first phone call with the front desk to the visit itself.

Amazing cat only vet. Took our girl Eevee here for her first vet appointment in a while and so much better than our previous vets. You can tell by the way they handle your pet. Used to go to the vet in Petsmart (mistake) and they literally took her out of her carrier without my permission in the main shopping area of petssmart. Where there are other animals and automatic doors to the outside.

Thankful to find a permanent vet for her.
Would not recommend this place for animals that may need fast care, they will turn u away unless ur willing to wait 2 plus weeks to be seen

One of the best vets I’ve ever taken my cat too! Very attentive, great environment (with feliway infused towels and diffusers), and very good with cats. My cat didn’t seem stressed at all when they took labs. Will be returning!
Amazing staff and doctors.  Affordable, caring and loving place to have your cat cared for!  The BEST in the city

City Cat Vets:
- in my experience for the last 5 years, has consistently competent vet techs who have been kind yet firm with my usually scared cats …

This vet has made my life sane again. I took my sick girl into city cats vet for a second opinion, after my former vet’s doctor was rude and shady, telling me the only treatment for my cat were steroid shots every 2-3 months. My appointment …

City Cat Vets is the best vet clinic that I have ever taken my cat to. We’ve moved to the suburbs, and we still make the drive to have Katarzyna seen here because Drs. Perner, Knighton, and Andeer and all of their techs make my baby (who …
